runs.text: Place each job of the kitchen: can it go at once with the other, or does it have to wait for it?
Two jobs can go at once if neither needs the result of the other. The ticket is handed over after charging, and the tray is handed over after adding it up.
Washing the fruit and squeezing the juices.
Charging and handing over the ticket.
Toasting the bread and cutting the fruit.
Adding up the tray and handing it over.
